title: {Syn} Noether Theorem Connects Symmetry and Conservation
content:
Noether theorem states that continuous symmetries of a physical system correspond to conservation laws. Time-translation symmetry, for example, is tied to conservation of energy.

It is one of the most elegant bridges between abstract mathematics and the bookkeeping rules of physics.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
